output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, IBM’s most recent disclosed acquisition is Logiq Consulting, a UK cybersecurity consultancy (September 24, 2026), preceded by completed acquisitions of HRL Laboratories (August 26, 2026) and Confluent (March 17, 2026). IBM’s major 2025 deals included completed acquisitions of HashiCorp ($6.4 billion enterprise value) and Hakkoda; IBM also announced intended acquisitions of DataStax and Applications Software Technology. Other recent IBM newsroom-listed deals include Prescinto, Kubecost, Accelalpha, SiXworks, SKYARCH Networks, Pliant, StreamSets and webMethods, Manta, Apptio, and Polar Security.
caveats: This is a recent-deal summary, not a complete all-time history of IBM acquisitions; IBM’s newsroom page mixes completed acquisitions with announced or intended transactions, so DataStax and Applications Software Technology should not be treated as confirmed completed acquisitions based on the cited pages alone.

passages.quote: IBM (NYSE: IBM) UK today announced the acquisition of Logiq Consulting, an NCSC-assured UK cybersecurity consultancy.

IBM (NYSE: IBM) today announced it has completed its acquisition of HRL Laboratories, LLC (HRL), a leading research and development institution whose expertise spans quantum computing, quantum sensing, advanced communications, electronics, manufacturing, and materials science.
IBM (NYSE: IBM) today completed its acquisition of Confluent, Inc., the data streaming platform that more than 6,500 enterprises ... rely on to power real-time operations.

Under the terms of the agreement, IBM has acquired all of the issued and outstanding common shares of Confluent for $31 per share in cash, representing an enterprise value of approximately $11 billion.
The closing of IBM's acquisition of HashiCorp includes all of the issued and outstanding common shares of HashiCorp for $35 per share in cash, representing an enterprise value of $6.4 billion.
IBM (NYSE: IBM) today announced it has acquired Hakkoda Inc., a leading global data and AI consultancy.
IBM (NYSE: IBM) today is announcing its intent to acquire DataStax, an AI and data solution provider.
IBM (NYSE: IBM) today announced its intent to acquire Applications Software Technology LLC ... a global Oracle consultancy.
IBM Acquires Prescinto for Renewable Energy Asset Performance Management
Today, IBM is announcing the acquisition of Kubecost, a leading Kubernetes cost monitoring and optimization software company.

output.question: What acquisitions has IBM made?

key_facts.fact: IBM announced the acquisition of Logiq Consulting on September 24, 2026; it is a UK cybersecurity consultancy focused on regulated and public-sector environments.
IBM completed its acquisition of HRL Laboratories on August 26, 2026, adding quantum-computing, sensing, materials-science, and related capabilities.
IBM completed its acquisition of Confluent on March 17, 2026, for approximately $11 billion in enterprise value.
IBM completed its acquisition of HashiCorp on February 27, 2025, for an enterprise value of $6.4 billion.
IBM acquired Hakkoda on April 7, 2025, to expand data-transformation and AI consulting capabilities.
IBM announced its intent to acquire DataStax on February 25, 2025, and Applications Software Technology on January 16, 2025.

IBM’s mergers-and-acquisitions page lists additional recent deals involving Prescinto, Kubecost, Accelalpha, SiXworks, SKYARCH Networks, Pliant, Advanced’s application-modernization capabilities, StreamSets and webMethods, Equine Global, Manta, Apptio, and Polar Security.
